an11.13:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ Nigrodhārāme.
an11.13:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ vassāvāsaṃ upagantukāmo hoti.
an11.13:2.3: Atha kho Nandiyassa Sakkassa etad ahosi
an11.13:2.5: tattha kammantañ c' eva adiṭṭhahissāmi Bhagavantañ ca lacchāmi kālena kālaṃ dassanāyā' ti.
an11.13:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ vassāvāsaṃ upagañchi,
an11.13:3.2: Nandiyo pi kho Sakko Sāvatthiyaṃ vassāvāsaṃ upagañchi,
an11.13:3.3: tattha kammantañ c' eva adhiṭṭhāsi Bhagavantañ ca labhi kālena kālaṃ dassanāya. 2.
an11.13:3.4: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū Bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
an11.13:4.2: sambahulā kira bhikkhū Bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
an11.13:4.4: Atha kho Nandiyo Sakko yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Nandiyo Sakko Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:--
an11.13:4.6: sambahulā kira bhikkhū Bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
an11.13:4.8: Tesaṃ no bhante nānāvihārehi viharitaṃ ken' assa vihārena vihātabban ti? 3.
an11.13:5.2: etaṃ kho Nandiya tumhākaṃ patirūpaṃ kulapattānaṃ, yaṃ tumhe Tathāgataṃ upasaṅkamitvā puccheyyātha
an11.13:5.3: ‘tesaṃ no bhante nānāvihārehi viharitaṃ ken' assa vihārena vihātabban' ti.
an11.13:5.4: Saddho kho Nandiya ārādhako hoti no asaddho,
an11.13:5.10: Imesu kho te Nandiya chasu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya pañcasu dhammesu ajjhattaṃ sati upaṭṭhapetabbā. 4.
an11.13:6.2: ‘iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi Satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho Bhagavā' ti.
an11.13:6.3: Iti kho te Nandiya Tathāgataṃ ārabbha ajjhattaṃ sati upaṭṭhapetabbā. 5.
an11.13:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ tvaṃ Nandiya dhammaṃ anussareyyāsi
an11.13:7.2: ‘svākkhāto Bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī' ti.
an11.13:7.3: Iti kho te Nandiya dhammaṃ ārabbha ajjhattaṃ sati upaṭṭhapetabbā. 6.
an11.13:8.1: Puna ca paraṃ Nandiya kalyāṇamitte anussareyyāsi
an11.13:8.3: yassa me kalyāṇamittā anukampakā atthakāmā ovādakā anusāsakā' ti.
an11.13:8.4: Iti kho te Nandiya kalyāṇamitte ārabbha ajjhattaṃ sati upaṭṭhapetabbā. 7.
an11.13:9.1: Puna ca paraṃ tvaṃ Nandiya attano cāgaṃ anussareyyāsi
an11.13:9.3: yo ' haṃ maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitāya pajāya vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasāmi muttacāgo payatapāṇī vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato' ti.
an11.13:9.4: Iti kho te Nandiya cāgaṃ ārabbha ajjhattaṃ sati upaṭṭhapetabbā. 8.
an11.13:10.1: Puna ca paraṃ tvaṃ Nandiya devatā anussareyyāsi
an11.13:10.2: ‘yā tā devatā atikkamm' eva kabaḷīkārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapannā, tā karaṇīyaṃ attano na samanupassanti katassa vā paticayaṃ;
an11.13:10.3: seyyathā pi Nandiya bhikkhu asamayavimutto karaṇīyaṃ attano na samanupassati katassa vā paticayaṃ,
an11.13:10.4: evam eva kho Nandiya yā tā devatā atikkamm' eva kabaḷīkārabhakkhānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapannā, tā karaṇīyaṃ attano na samanupassanti katassa vā paticayan' ti.
an11.13:10.5: Iti kho te Nandiya devatā ārabbha ajjhattaṃ sati upaṭṭhapetabbā.
an11.13:11.1: Imehi kho Nandiya ekādasahi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako pajahat' eva pāpake akusale dhamme na upādiyati.
an11.13:11.2: Seyyathā pi Nandiya kumbho nikkujjo 'va tam eva udakaṃ no vantaṃ paccāvamati,
an11.13:11.3: seyyathā pi vā pana Nandiya sukkhe tiṇadāye aggi mutto ḍahaṃ yeva gacchati, no daḍḍhaṃ paccudāvattati,
an11.13:11.4: evam eva kho Nandiya imehi ekādasahi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako pajahat' eva pāpake akusale dhamme na upādiyatī
